{
  "name": "lightbox",
  "version": "0.3.2",
  "description": "Shows the images you paste and the ones Claude reads, receives or creates in a small strip above the prompt: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, BMP and SVG.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Nuko Nova Dynamics",
    "email": "hello@nukonova.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/nuko-nova-dynamics/lightbox",
  "repository": "https://github.com/nuko-nova-dynamics/lightbox",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "images",
    "screenshots",
    "terminal",
    "heic"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show new images",
      "description": "Show the strip above the prompt again when a new image arrives, after you hid it. Off, a toast says one arrived.",
      "default": true
    },
    "renderer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How pictures are drawn",
      "description": "auto: real pixels where Claude Code draws them, colored character cells elsewhere (herdr, tmux, SSH). cells: always cells. pixels: always pixels, which show as the image's name where Claude Code does not draw pictures.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "cells",
        "pixels"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "cellAspect": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Cell height to width",
      "description": "How many times taller than wide one terminal cell is, so pictures keep their proportions. About 2.1 for most fonts; more with taller lines, such as Ghostty's adjust-cell-height.",
      "min": 1,
      "max": 4,
      "default": 2.1
    }
  }
}
